scientific_integrity: The explicit minimax formulas, not the known electrical path identity, convexity, or SDP formulation, are the stated contribution. Comparable formulations in uninspected literature remain a possible originality risk. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for a fixed star with at least two leaves, positive linear edge prices, and a total conductance cost budget; no claim about arbitrary trees or cyclic networks.
title: An exact dominant-price threshold for resistance-diameter design on stars
